paite: Heutute aw, nou leng vanah Heutupa na neih uh theiin, na sikhate u tungah a dik a tang leh a kilawm hih un.
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

paite: Thum ngitnget unla, huaiah tuh kipahthu gen kawmin limsak un.
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

paite: Hena ka omlouh pen kris thuguk tuh gen dingin Pathianin thu adia kong a honhonsak theihna dingin, kou leng honthum sak un,
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

paite: Ka gen ding bangtaka ka gen khiak theihna dingin.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

paite: Hun na neih sungun atam theipen sem jel unla, polama mite lakah pil takin om un.
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

paite: Mi chih bangchibanga dawn chiat ding ahi ua chih na theihna ding un, na paukamsuak utuh, chi soh, hehpihna hi gige hen.
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

paite: Toupaa unau ngaihtak, nasempa muanhuai, sikha hihpih Tukikalin ka tanchin tengteng nou a hontheisak ding hi.
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

paite: Hiai jiak mahin, amah tuh na kiang uah ka honsawl ahi, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uleh, na lungtang uh a hihkhamuan theihna dingin;
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

paite: Onesima, unau muanhuai leh ngaihtak noumau laka mi mah toh. Amau tuh hiai lama thil omdan tengteng a honthei sak ding uh.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

paite: Aristarkha ka hentakpihpan nou chibai a honbuk hi. Marka, Barnaba tupain leng, chibai a honbuk hi (amah tungtang thu ah thupiakte na mu uh; na kiang ua a hongpai leh, na kipahpih un);
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

paite: Jesu, Justa a chih un chibai nou a honbuk hi. Huaite tuh zeksum mi ahi ua, huaite kia Pathian gam thu lamah ka seppih, a honkhamuante ahi uhi.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for the Kingdom of God who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

paite: Epaphra noumau laka, Kris Jesu sikhain chibai nou a honbuk hi, aman tuh Pathian deihlam phot pichin leh gin bikbekna neia na din theihna ding un, a thumna ah nou adingin a kisuk gige hi.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

paite: Noumau ading bang, Leodisia khuaa omte ading bang, Hierapoli khuaa omte ading bangin phatuam a ngai mahmah chih ka theihpih ngel hi.
english: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

paite: Luka daktor ngaihtak leh Demain nou chibai a honbuk uhi.
english: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.

paite: Leodisia khuaa unau omte, huaite chibai honbuk sak un.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.

paite: Huan, hiai laikhak na lak ua na sim nung un, Leodisia saptuamte lakah leng sim sak un aw; nou leng leodisia khuaa pen nana sim sam ding ua.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

paite: Huan, Arkippa kiangah, nasepna Toupaa i muh pen tangtun dingin pilvang in, na chi un.Kei Paulain keimah khut ngeingeia hiai chibai honbukna kon-gelh ahi. Ka kolbulhte theigige un. Hehpihna na kiang uah om hen. Amen.
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

paite: Kei Paulain keimah khut ngeingeia hiai chibai honbukna kon-gelh ahi. Ka kolbulhte theigige un. Hehpihna na kiang uah om hen. Amen.
english: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
